headline: "It will lead to scarcity and a sharp rise in prices". Beverage producers call for reviewing quotas on sugar imports
summary: UzBev warns that restricting white sugar imports could cause shortages and higher product prices, estimating sugar prices could rise 15-28%. It urges quotas to be suspended.
why: Sugar is a key input for beverage producers, so import restrictions and supply gaps can raise input costs and consumer prices.
original_headline: “Taqchillik va narxlarning keskin oshishiga olib boradi”. Ichimlik ishlab chiqaruvchilar shakar importiga kvotalarni qayta ko‘rib chiqishga chaqirdi
